clips.title: The story
paras: Agathelos the Raging is a colossal armored boar penned within the thorned tunnels of Razorfen Kraul. To the quilboar, whose god and progenitor is the great boar Agamaggan, a beast of his size carries considerable spiritual significance, and he grows even more fearsome when enraged. His sheer mass and strength make him one of the most dangerous beasts lurking under the southern Barrens.

The god and progenitor of the quilboar is Agamaggan, a titanic boar. A beast the size of Agathelos—standing roughly twice as tall as a Barrens thunder lizard—therefore carries considerable spiritual significance among the Razorfen tribes.
